subject: Analog Electronics
questionText:
In the circuit shown in figure, Vo = 3 V when IL = 0 
and Vo changes by 40 mV per 1 mA of load current. 
Find the value of R (assume all four diodes are 
identical) relative to a diode with 0.7 V drop at 1 mA 
current. Assume  = 1. 
 
 
(a) 7.6  
(b) 9.8  
 
(c) 4.8  
(d) 5 
explanation: Practice Question from Analog Electronics DPP-02 (Analog Electronics Practice Sheet 02).
